carrier: 2-local Cube27 ordinary split Green order R_(2), augmentation ideal I_(2), and its I-adic completion

associated_graded.source: II-KI exact normalized lattice period-two theorem plus II-KM 2-local filtration

completion_exactness.statement: 0 -> completed(I^(n+1)_(2)) -> completed(I^n_(2)) -> gr^n_{I,(2)}R -> 0 is exact for every n>=1
completion_exactness.reason: R_(2) is Noetherian and the modules are finite; I-adic completion is exact on finite modules in the frozen Noetherian setting

proof: R_(2) is finite free over Z_(2), hence Z_(2)-flat
the I-adic completion Rhat_(2) is flat over the Noetherian ring R_(2)
therefore Rhat_(2) is flat, hence torsion-free, over Z_(2)
the injection I^n_(2) -> R_(2) remains injective after tensoring with the flat Rhat_(2)
for finite modules, completed(I^n_(2)) = I^n_(2) tensor_{R_(2)} Rhat_(2), so it embeds in Rhat_(2)

completed_extension_nonsplitting.statement: for every n>=1 the completed filtration exact sequence does not split as a Z_(2)-module (hence not as a continuous Rhat_(2)-module or topological-algebra extension)
completed_extension_nonsplitting.proof: a splitting would inject the nonzero 2-primary torsion quotient gr^n into the Z_(2)-torsion-free middle term completed(I^n_(2)), impossible
completed_extension_nonsplitting.scope: splitting of the completed augmentation-filtration extension; distinct from the conductor Ext^1 class

topological_algebra_presentation.inverse_limit_presentation: Rhat_(2) = lim_m R_(2)/I^m_(2) as a complete separated I-adic topological algebra

guards: associated-graded period two is not a splitting theorem
the conductor Ext class and the filtered Rees extension classes remain distinct carriers
no new polynomial presentation is manufactured
completion exactness and nonsplitting are compatible: exact does not mean split
